# Vendored Supabase client

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD bundle of `@supabase/supabase-js` 2.49.8.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.49.8/dist/umd/supabase.js

SHA-256: `522e844a8554c84631063fa630d0b824b8042f346a0222da04460f81d942dcf8`

MIT license: `LICENSE`. Upstream: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js.
No CDN request is needed when the demo runs. Database and web Docker images must be downloaded during online preparation.
